pr_body:
This PR adds missing call to clear last successful authentication cache,
when clear all realm cache action is called.

Fixes #86650
pr_title: Fix clearing of lastSuccessfulAuthCache when clear all realm cache API is called
pr_comment: Hi @slobodanadamovic, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: We could also assert `expireAll` is not called.
Can't we just mock the `CachingRealm` interface?

Unfortunately, we can't. Reason is because `Realms` hold `Realm` objects not `CachingRealm`. 
I thought of using `CachingUsernamePasswordRealm` instead, but this abstract class has made `expire` and `expireAll` methods final. Hence why I decided to introduce `TestCachingRealm`. I'm not super happy about it, but I did not see other options.
All good. Thanks for the explanation.
